The back of this case picks up everything. Fingerprints and every piece of lint and dust floating around you. I wouldn’t call that a “Flawless” look. Other than that the case is fine and fits perfect. Buttons are good, sturdy. Just really disappointed that they didn’t even try to put something on the back of the case so it wouldn’t stay smudged up. You can tell because even the smudges are hard to rub off. You really have to rub hard to get the smudges off the back of the case. The three stars is because the company has great customer service and the case fits good and tight. It also looks like it would protect the camera lenses pretty well. They just should’ve used a different kind of material on the back or at least put an oleophobic coating on it so it would get less smudges and attract less dust and lint and make the smudges easier to wipe off. I got the frosted black model. If they would’ve used a harder material on the back or gave it some texture that would’ve almost solved the smudgyness of the back. There are better cases for the money.

Update: Added a star because ESR has great customer service. Offered a replacement or refund because I wasn't completely happy.
